title: weight limit
text:
weight limit. These shelves are pretty good. They look nice and are easy to install. I'm not a big fan of the lip, though. For those of you concerned about how much weight they can hold, I have a 9lb piece on the smallest one and it's starting to pull it out of the wall. I'm not mechanical at all but I would think the smallest one would be the sturdiest because the anchors are closer together, so keep that in mind.
The built-in level is pretty good. I saw a couple of reviews questioning their accuracy but it seems to have worked for me.

All in all, I need more shelves and am looking into other options.
